text:
ashton: canary perf alert — smallbatch p95 jumped ~2.3x after the nvrtc/torch bump rolled this morning. seeing on 2x A100 pools. cc @sasha @pranav :eyes:

sasha: ugh. which job/commit? any flamegraphs yet?

ashton: job -> https://ci.redwood.internal/job/rt-canary/642 (latency test harness). commit = 7f3c9b2 (torch2.6.1 + nvrtc 23.3.1 change). failing run attached in CI logs.

ci-bot: Build rt-canary/642 summary:
- p95 smallbatch: 42ms -> 97ms
- throughput (tokens/s): -18%
- artifacts: s3://artifacts/rt-canary/642/perf/*.svg

pranav: can you paste the perf flame and a brief stack? my hunch is kernel selection/priority inversion in matmul path after nvrtc symbol resolution tweak.

ashton: adding flame (s3 link) and short profiling snippet:
```
# top 5 by self-time
matmul_kernel_generic  48.7%
matmul_kernel_opt1     21.2%
kv_prefetch_worker      9.8%
dispatch_selector       8.4%
memcpy_async            6.1%
```
Looks like more time in the generic matmul kernel + prefetch stall.

sasha: that points to kernel heuristic flip (opt1 became less preferred). Did autotune table change? any Triton warnings in logs?

ashton: no autotune writes in this run. but build logs show nvrtc invoked with `--relocate-which-symbols` toggled (weird linker-ish flag from the new nvrtc). cc plumbed via our torch build.

pranav: can we bisect the nvrtc/Torch change quickly? try reverting the nvrtc flag in the build and rebuild canary. if it repros locally maybe we can hotfix.

ashton: started a quick bisect: `git checkout 7f3c9b2^ && ./build.sh --nvrtc-compat old-rt` then run perf harness. ETA ~20m.

liz: if that isolates it, we should open a revert PR and hold rollout for the Docker tag. this is a rollout blocker for Dedicated customers.

deploy-bot: Canary deploy triggered: rt-canary:v2026-03-18-743 (with nvrtc-compat=old-rt)

ashton: bisect result: reverting the nvrtc symbol-resolution toggle brings p95 back to 40ms. confirmed on 3 runs.

pranav: nice. root cause: nvrtc change causes different PTX register allocation which makes Triton pick generic matmul instead of opt1 for 64x64 cases -> prefetch misses + kv stall. We'll detail in the PR.

liz: opened revert PR https://git.redwood/internal/p/r/2987 — mark as urgent and add gating.

sasha: also added a short test to CI that compares kernel choice baseline for tiny batches so this doesn't slip. minimal: run perf selector on our 64x64 workload and fail if opt1 not chosen.

deploy-bot: Revert PR merged to canary branch and new image pushed: rt-canary:v2026-03-18-748

ashton: canary metrics after revert:
- p95 smallbatch: 38ms -> 41ms (back to baseline)
- tokens/s back within 3% of previous

pranav: follow-up actions: file issue with NVRTC vendor, add autotune guardrail, and include kernel-choice assertion in smoke CI.

ashton: thanks all. leaving canary open for a few hours then promote. closing thread unless anyone sees leftover signals. :thumbsup:
